 Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Who is the perfect fit for Maropost?
 
 
 
Are you a fast-growing mid-market ecommerce brand or retailer with $20–$200M in revenue, ready to outgrow the limits of your current tech stack? Maropost is ideal for you. Our unified commerce platform can help you simplify operations, connect marketing, commerce, and service, and turn every customer interaction into a smooth, personalized experience.
Who would be a perfect fit? E-commerce businesses, multi-channel e-commerce sellers, and multi-store retailers and distributors across sectors like:
Automotive
Travel & tourism
Sports & recreation
Home & garden
Consumer electronics
Gifting
Media & entertainment
B2B & wholesale
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What exactly is a unified commerce platform?
 
 
 
A unified commerce platform integrates all customer touchpoints and business operations into a single system. It means you can manage all your online, in-store, and mobile sales, along with your inventory, customer information, and order fulfillment, from one central place. No more struggling with separate tools that don't talk to each other.
The primary goal is to provide a consistent, frictionless, and personalized shopping experience for your customers across all channels, while also giving you a holistic view of your operations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can I manage both my online e-commerce store and my physical retail locations on one platform?
 
 
 
Yes! The entire concept of a unified commerce platform is built around effortlessly managing both your online e-commerce store and your physical retail locations from a single, centralized system – and Maropost offers exactly that. Maropost Commerce Cloud and Retail Cloud work together to break down the typical silos between digital and physical channels and provide a single view of inventory, POS, and loyalty across all touchpoints.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What sets Maropost apart from similar solutions?
 
 
 
With Maropost, everything works together smoothly. Every product in our platform – from marketing to commerce to service – is powered by the same data and AI insights, giving you a complete, consistent view of your customers across every single channel. This enables you to

 Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is Maropost Commerce Cloud?
 
 
 
Maropost Commerce Cloud is a modern AI-driven commerce platform that lets you manage storefronts, product catalogs, inventory, pricing, orders, fulfillment, and customers from a single back-office solution. With Commerce Cloud, you can build and run your online store, process sales in-store, sell across marketplaces, and manage your multi-market ecommerce business – all from one platform. It’s fast, modular, deeply integrated, and built for the way commerce works today, not 10 years ago.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Who is the perfect fit for Maropost Commerce Cloud?
 
 
 
We’ve built Commerce Cloud for mid-market retailers generating $20–$200M in GMV and managing large, complex catalogs of 50K–1M SKUs. It’s a perfect fit for ecommerce merchants and retailers who have outgrown their current platforms and need more control, speed, scalability, and AI-driven intelligence to grow their business faster with fewer tools, less overhead, and better ROI.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Why would I choose Commerce Cloud over other popular ecommerce platforms?
 
 
 
Maropost Commerce Cloud isn’t just another clone of the world’s most popular ecommerce platforms. It’s a next-generation solution that brings together enterprise-level scalability, mid-market agility, and AI-powered intelligence. And because it’s part of Maropost’s unified platform, it lets you connect commerce, merchandising, and marketing under one roof to help you run a successful business.
Here’s why you’d want to switch to Maropost Commerce Cloud:
Simplified tech stack:
 Consolidate your tech stack without sacrificing performance – Commerce Cloud can replace multiple tools, reducing cost, friction, and vendor headache.
End-to-end control:
 From storefront management to products, inventory, orders, and fulfillment – you own and manage your entire commerce engine with a single solution.
Built-in merchandising engine:
 Easily handle complex SKUs, bundles, kits, and pricing tiers with ease.
Scalable for global growth: 
Expand confidently with a multi-store, multi-region architecture built right in. Manage multiple storefronts, brands, and currencies – all from the same platform.
Natively integrates with other Maropost tools: 
Connect directly to Maropost Marketing Cloud for smarter cross-channel campaigns and Maropost Merchandising Cloud for AI product recommendations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can Maropost Commerce Cloud integrate with my tech stack?
 
 
 
Maropost Commerce Cloud offers modern, high-performance APIs for easy custom integrations. Plus, it comes with native connections to tools like ShipStation, Stripe, PayPal, Google Analytics, and more. On top of that, Commerce Cloud seamlessly integrates with the entire Maropost ecosystem.
Ultimately, Maropost brings everything together – it’s your storefront builder, catalog management platform, order management and fulfillment platform, and more – making it the only solution you’ll ever need.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How easy is it to switch from my current ecommerce platform to Maropost Commerce Cloud?
 
 
 
While that largely depends on your store's size and complexity, our built-in migration tools simplify and streamline the process. You can easily import your existing data using .csv file uploads. Whether you want to tackle it yourself or have our experts walk you through it, the entire process is often smoother than you'd expect!

 Frequently Asked Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 How do I know if Maropost is a good fit for my business?
 
 
 
Maropost is designed to personalize and accelerate shopping experiences across channels. We provide solutions for every aspect of your brand’s growth, including marketing, commerce, operations, and service. Here are the ways Maropost can accelerate your brand’s growth:
 
Global: 
 
 
 Marketing Cloud: Automate email, mobile, social media, and SMS marketing seamlessly. 
 
 
 Service Cloud: Consolidate customer interactions across marketing, sales, and service for a holistic view of every customer. 
 
 
 Merchandising Cloud: Create a seamless shopping experience by hyper-personalizing recommendations, search, and discovery
 
 
 
 
Australia/New Zealand: 
 
 
 
 Neto: Build ecommerce sites, control inventory, and monitor real-time performance. 
 
 
 Retail Express: Transform and scale retail operations with powerful point-of-sale software.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Can Maropost integrate with my existing tech stack?
 
 
 
 Yes, Maropost seamlessly integrates with leading ecommerce, data, and marketing platforms. With hundreds of integrations, you can sync data across ecommerce, email, SMS, web, and analytics sources. For granular control, our API allows customization. Explore all integrations 
here
.
 
 
 
 
 
 When and how are payments made?
 
 
 
Maropost contracts have a 12-month commitment for optimal success. Billing can be arranged monthly or annual basis.
 
 
 
 
 Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan whenever I want?
 
 
 
You can upgrade your plan anytime to meet your growing needs. Downgrades are available at the end of your current contract term to ensure a smooth transition for your business.
 
 
 
 
 What kind of support will I receive with Maropost?
 
 
 
At Maropost, we are committed to providing comprehensive support. All of our customers enjoy 24/7 support via chat or email. We also have a full library of how-to articles and a collection of recorded and live webinars facilitated by our product experts, and a blog sharing commerce best practices.
